lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
Medicare Advantage: defers to NCDs 20.15, 20.36, 20.27 and First Coast LCD L39492 / article A59270
criteria_location: Position Statement, PDF pp.3-4 (one page of bullets). ICD-10 'support medical necessity' lists in Billing/Coding and a documentation line (history & physical, progress notes, labs) in Billing/Coding. Nothing in Definitions.
procedures_covered: External patient/auto-activated ambulatory event monitors and continuous ambulatory monitors >48 h (93241-93248, 93268-93272)
Implantable ambulatory event monitor / loop recorder (33285, 33286, E0616)
CardioMEMS pulmonary artery pressure sensor (33289, 93264, G0555) - investigational
Mobile apps / other AEM uses - investigational

logic.top_level: pathways (one block per device type, each with its own any-of indications; MCOT block is all-of with a nested one-of)

k_of_n.quote: The member has ONE of the following: 1. A history of cryptogenic stroke; or 2. Recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope or presyncope of suspected arrhythmic etiology.

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No NOT list. Exclusions are a closing 'does not meet' sentence per device (MCOT 'does not meet the definition of medical necessity for all other indications including... ongoing management after diagnosis, medication management, screening, or monitoring members with life-threatening arrhythmias') plus a catch-all experimental/investigational paragraph.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No repeat-study or replacement rule at all (contrast Excellus/Curative 1-year repeat rule). Only 33286 removal listed.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Members with atrial fibrillation who have been treated with catheter ablation, and in whom discontinuation of systemic anticoagulation is being considered; OR
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Bullets 1-3 are joined only by a trailing 'OR' after the second bullet; reader must infer all three are alternatives. 'and' inside bullet 2 joins two conditions.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In the small subset of members who experience recurrent symptoms so infrequently that a prior trial of other external ambulatory event monitors has been unsuccessful; OR In members who require long-term monitoring for atrial fibrillation or possible atrial fibrillation.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second ILR indication has no prerequisite at all (no external monitor trial, no stroke, no ablation); 'possible atrial fibrillation' is nearly unbounded.

vague_terms.problem: 'standard work-up' not defined beyond 24-hour Holter; imaging/echo/vascular not enumerated

vague_terms.quote: non-diagnostic trial of external ambulatory event monitoring
vague_terms.problem: no definition of non-diagnostic (no events captured vs. captured but normal?)

vague_terms.quote: in whom discontinuation of systemic anticoagulation is being considered
vague_terms.problem: intent of clinician; may not be in chart
not a criterion; descriptive wording embedded in a criterion
no definitions section despite terms like MCOT, AEM, cryptogenic

extraction_hazards: Navigation bar (Position Statement / Billing/Coding / ...) flattened into page 1 text
Bullets rendered as private-use glyphs; numbered '1. 2.' sub-list nested under bullet
Long CPT/ICD tables with descriptions wrapped across lines
'Summary and Analysis of Evidence' is one dense paragraph that reads like criteria but is rationale
LOINC table with repeated 'six months' narrative cells
interesting_structures: Device-type pathways in one short page
MCOT requires prior failed external monitor within 60 days (a tiered/escalation ladder external -> ILR / MCOT)
MCOT limited to two indications; broad 'does not meet' for ongoing management, screening, life-threatening arrhythmias

fit_to_tree.why: Short, mostly any-of indications with a few all-of blocks; thresholds are few. Hazards are undefined words (non-diagnostic, standard work-up) and clinician-intent conditions, not structure.
